title: FundingClaw: Automated Grant Proposal Writing Agents System
abstract: arXiv:2611.19157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Grant proposal writing remains a manual, labor-intensive bottleneck: proposals must satisfy rigid, agency-specific templates, and the same intellectual content must be repeatedly re-encoded into incompatible formats across funding organizations. We introduce FundingClaw, a multi-agent framework built on template-driven skill selection, where a Template Parser ingests any agency's specification and selects the appropriate writing skills for each stage, so that one research brief can produce compliant proposals for NSFC, NSF, KAKENHI, or ERC without modifying generation logic. A blueprint-skeleton strategy drafts a structured outline before any prose is written, mitigating the semantic drift that plagues long-form generation. Three sequential stages produce the rationale, research content, and research foundation sections, with multi-source verification of the PI's record and optional PDF-grounded extraction of representative works. translated_title: FundingClaw：自动化基金申请书撰写智能体系统
translated_abstract: 基金申请书撰写仍然是一个依赖人工、劳动密集型的瓶颈环节：申请书必须满足僵化的、资助机构专属的模板要求，而且同样的学术内容必须在不同的资助机构之间被反复地重新编码为互不兼容的格式。我们提出了FundingClaw，这是一个建立在模板驱动技能选择之上的多智能体框架：模板解析器（Template Parser）可以读取任何资助机构的申报规范，并为每个写作阶段选择合适的技能，使得一份研究简报无需修改生成逻辑，即可生成符合国家自然科学基金委（NSFC）、美国国家科学基金会（NSF）、日本KAKENHI或欧洲研究理事会（ERC）要求的合规申请书。蓝图-骨架（blueprint-skeleton）策略在任何正文撰写之前先起草结构化大纲，从而缓解了长文本生成中普遍存在的语义漂移问题。三个顺序执行的阶段分别生成立项依据、研究内容和研究基础部分，并对项目负责人的学术履历进行多来源核验，同时支持可选的基于PDF的代表性成果提取。
tldr: FundingClaw是一个模板驱动的多智能体框架，通过模板解析与蓝图-骨架策略，能够将一份研究简报自动转换为符合NSFC、NSF、KAKENHI或ERC等不同资助机构格式要求的基金申请书。
en_tdlr: FundingClaw is a template-driven multi-agent framework that uses a template parser and a blueprint-skeleton strategy to automatically transform a single research brief into compliant grant proposals for different funding agencies such as NSFC, NSF, KAKENHI, or ERC.
